data.name: The Repeating Knot
data.detailed_description:
The Repeating Knot is a psychological survival horror set in a small Polish town — a love letter to fans of classic horror games such as Silent Hill and Resident Evil. Explore a world torn between reality and nightmare, uncover the secrets of the past, and fight for survival in a place where dreams and waking life become indistinguishable.

You play as Tomo, a lonely, aging fast-food worker who dreams of becoming a successful vlogger and streamer. Desperate to escape the monotony of his everyday life and his growing sense of failure, he continuously chases online recognition but never seems to achieve it. As the line between reality and nightmare begins to blur, Tomo is forced to confront his fears, memories, and the mistakes he has spent years trying to ignore.

The story takes place in Wodzisław Śląski, a town inspired by real-world locations. Abandoned streets, faded apartment blocks, dense fog, and ever-present dampness create the atmosphere of a place suspended somewhere between memory and oblivion.

Inspired by the classic horror games of the PlayStation 2 era, The Repeating Knot focuses on tension, exploration, and psychological dread. A dynamic camera system combines cinematic angles with player-tracking perspectives, creating a constant sense of unease as you uncover the truth hidden beneath the town's decaying surface.

Your most important tool is a radio flashlight that reacts to the presence of creatures from another dimension. Its static and interference warn you of danger, but never reveal the full truth about what lurks in the darkness.

The world is inhabited by a variety of hostile creatures, each with its own behaviors and hunting patterns. Some react to light, others to sound, while certain enemies can strike and disappear before you have time to react. Every encounter requires observation, caution, and careful resource management.

Limited ammunition, healing supplies, and light sources make survival a constant challenge. Solve environmental puzzles, explore forgotten locations, and uncover fragments of the story as you struggle to stay alive. Every mistake may have consequences.

Beyond the nightmare lies everyday life. Work, routine, and repetitive tasks slowly bleed into the world of horror, transforming familiar activities into sources of anxiety and dread. With every step, the boundary between ordinary life and madness grows thinner.

Key Features

• Psychological survival horror inspired by genre classics.
• A dark story set in the atmosphere of a small Polish town.
• Dynamic camera system inspired by PlayStation 2-era horror games.
• A radio flashlight that warns of threats from another dimension.
• Unique enemies with behaviors influenced by light and sound.
• Resource management, exploration, and environmental puzzles.
• A setting inspired by Polish apartment blocks, fog, and everyday monotony.
• A story about loneliness, obsession, failure, and the inability to escape one's own cycle.

data.short_description: The Repeating Knot is a psychological survival horror set in a decaying Polish town. Explore distorted memories, survive grotesque creatures, and uncover the truth behind a nightmare where routine, guilt, and reality become impossible to separate.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400, AMD: Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel: i5-11400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce RTX 30660
  • DirectX: Version 12

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains combat against hostile creatures and monsters. Players can defeat and kill enemies, and blood effects are present during combat. The player character can also be injured and die as a result of enemy attacks. The game includes depictions of violence and blood throughout gameplay.
